name: cutive
description: The design of Cutive, and this monospace sister family Cutive Mono , is based on a number of classic typewriter typefaces, in particular the faces of IBM's 'Executive,' and the older 'Smith-Premier.' In Cutive these old faces re-emerge as webfonts that are useful for adding character to body texts as well as in larger sizes for headers and display. To contribute to the project see github.com/googlefonts/CutiveFont .
